before.reason: The script facts regarding Sam (a 10-year-old character depicted in scenes with rifle volleys, night watercraft travel, a burning boat, fireworks, and a stone jetty) are accurate. The premise regarding minor entitlement to a qualified stunt double for hazardous activities is supported by SAG-AFTRA Young Performers Safety Tips. If cast with a minor performer, production must strictly comply with CSATF Procedural Guideline #1 ('Special Procedures For Minors Performing Physical Activities') and SAG-AFTRA Young Performer regulations.
